title: Basque Shrimp Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish featuring succulent shrimp and the rich flavors of the Basque region. This recipe combines the freshness of luscious herbs with the depth of garlic for a truly unforgettable taste experience.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the Basque paprika and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the pil pil rice and stir to coat with the paprika mixture.
Add the cooked shrimp back into the skillet and stir to combine with the rice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
